fixes.issue: GC requests a missing specialist role for itself and deadlocks before commissioning
fixes.cause: request_role queued suspension of the caller even when caller and commissioning GC were the same assignment. wake then saw the pre-update running GC record and queued no launch.
fixes.change: Suspend the requesting assignment only when it differs from the commissioning GC. The self-requesting GC stays active to commission; commission(wait=True) uses the existing suspension and capacity flow.

fixes.issue: Role commissioning bypasses the configured dynamic blacklist
fixes.cause: delegate invoked held_role(ctx); commission created work without that existing configured check.
fixes.change: Use the same held_role(ctx) check and refusal before commission resolves or creates work. No new role policy or fixed list.

regression_source: The reported test_review_regressions.py was absent from this checkout and the current main tree. Two equivalent behavioral reproductions were added under that name, and both failures were captured before the fix.
runtime_scope: Actual runner/ACP/MCP fixtures and a separate real model/harness journey are recorded separately.
